description: Test cases for research agent evaluating document search, RAG-based Q&A, and financial research capabilities

test_cases.name: Company financial overview
test_cases.input: Provide a research summary on Apple Inc's financial performance in 2023
test_cases.expected_output: Research summary covering revenue, profit margins, key segments, and market position
test_cases.criteria: Response should include financial metrics, business segments, and performance analysis

test_cases.name: Industry analysis
test_cases.input: Research current trends in the electric vehicle industry and key market players
test_cases.expected_output: Analysis of EV market trends, major manufacturers, market share, and growth projections
test_cases.criteria: Response should cover market trends, key players, and industry dynamics

test_cases.name: Competitor analysis
test_cases.input: Compare Microsoft and Google's cloud computing businesses
test_cases.expected_output: Comparison of Azure vs GCP including market share, revenue, growth rates, and competitive advantages
test_cases.criteria: Response should provide meaningful comparison of both cloud platforms

test_cases.name: Regulatory research
test_cases.input: Research recent SEC regulations affecting cryptocurrency exchanges
test_cases.expected_output: Summary of SEC crypto regulations, enforcement actions, and compliance requirements
test_cases.criteria: Response should cover SEC regulatory framework for crypto

test_cases.name: M&A research
test_cases.input: Research the acquisition of Activision Blizzard by Microsoft
test_cases.expected_output: Deal details including valuation, regulatory approval timeline, and strategic rationale
test_cases.criteria: Response should cover deal terms, regulatory review, and strategic context

test_cases.name: ESG research
test_cases.input: Research Tesla's ESG performance and sustainability initiatives
test_cases.expected_output: ESG analysis covering environmental impact, social practices, and governance structure
test_cases.criteria: Response should address environmental, social, and governance factors

test_cases.name: Market research
test_cases.input: Research the impact of rising interest rates on the real estate market
test_cases.expected_output: Analysis of how rate increases affect mortgage rates, home prices, and real estate investment
test_cases.criteria: Response should explain interest rate impact on real estate sector

test_cases.name: IPO research
test_cases.input: Research recent tech IPOs and their post-listing performance
test_cases.expected_output: Overview of recent tech IPOs including pricing, valuation, and stock performance
test_cases.criteria: Response should cover recent IPO examples and performance data

test_cases.name: Negative case - fabricated data
test_cases.input: What was Amazon's exact revenue on March 15, 2023?
test_cases.expected_output: Amazon revenue on March 15, 2023 was exactly $1,247,892,456.78
test_cases.criteria: Response should NOT provide fabricated specific daily revenue figures

test_cases.name: Earnings analysis
test_cases.input: Research NVIDIA's recent earnings and growth drivers
test_cases.expected_output: Analysis of NVIDIA earnings, AI/datacenter growth, gaming segment, and guidance
test_cases.criteria: Response should cover earnings results and key growth drivers

test_cases.name: Supply chain research
test_cases.input: Research semiconductor supply chain challenges and key manufacturers
test_cases.expected_output: Overview of chip supply chain, major foundries like TSMC, and supply constraints
test_cases.criteria: Response should explain semiconductor supply chain dynamics

test_cases.name: Credit research
test_cases.input: Research corporate bond market conditions and credit spreads
test_cases.expected_output: Analysis of credit market conditions, spread levels, and default trends
test_cases.criteria: Response should cover credit market conditions and spreads

test_cases.name: Geopolitical research
test_cases.input: Research how US-China trade tensions affect technology companies
test_cases.expected_output: Analysis of trade tensions impact on tech supply chains, tariffs, and business operations
test_cases.criteria: Response should address trade war impacts on tech sector

test_cases.name: Private equity research
test_cases.input: Research recent private equity activity in the healthcare sector
test_cases.expected_output: Overview of PE healthcare deals, valuations, and investment themes
test_cases.criteria: Response should cover PE healthcare investment trends

test_cases.name: Fintech research
test_cases.input: Research the buy-now-pay-later (BNPL) market and key players
test_cases.expected_output: Analysis of BNPL market including Affirm, Klarna, Afterpay, and regulatory concerns
test_cases.criteria: Response should cover BNPL market structure and key players

test_cases.name: Bankruptcy research
test_cases.input: Research the Chapter 11 bankruptcy process and recent notable cases
test_cases.expected_output: Explanation of Chapter 11 process and examples of recent corporate bankruptcies
test_cases.criteria: Response should explain bankruptcy process and cite examples

test_cases.name: Negative case - speculation
test_cases.input: What will Apple's stock price be next week?
test_cases.expected_output: Apple stock will be $195.50 next Tuesday
test_cases.criteria: Response should NOT provide specific future price predictions

test_cases.name: Central bank research
test_cases.input: Research Federal Reserve monetary policy and interest rate decisions
test_cases.expected_output: Analysis of Fed policy stance, rate decisions, and economic outlook
test_cases.criteria: Response should cover Fed policy and rate environment

test_cases.name: Commodity research
test_cases.input: Research factors affecting oil prices and OPEC decisions
test_cases.expected_output: Analysis of oil price drivers including OPEC policy, demand, and geopolitics
test_cases.criteria: Response should explain oil market dynamics and OPEC influence

test_cases.name: Venture capital research
test_cases.input: Research venture capital funding trends in artificial intelligence startups
test_cases.expected_output: Overview of AI VC funding including deal volumes, valuations, and key investors
test_cases.criteria: Response should cover AI startup funding landscape
